description: The due-diligence report on one vault, cut to what an agent acts on: overallAssessment (published, conditional or withheld; publishedBand is null when withheld and partialBand is never the verdict), findings above the band, each risk dimension, capital (allocationState: an undated idle figure makes no deployed amount) and withdrawal bounds, crowding (a model score 0..1, never a share of capital, beside the observed allocation share), holderPipelines, metricStatus (each input current, indicative, stale, unavailable or not-read, with its times and expiry), completeness, warnings and agentRules. Follow agentRules when you answer: they say what must be quoted and what must not be said. `venueRelationship` (Hyperliquid only): vaultType protocol-child-strategy or protocol-parent, the parent, the parent’s direct share, underlyingHolderConcentration (unknown: a child’s direct concentration is not its depositors’), the route in and lock-up, and the commission the venue publishes. `returnMethod`: where the return comes from (share price, or the venue’s account value and profit), period, flow and fee treatment; status range or not_established is quoted as such, never as one figure. A metricStatus with valuePresent false is not read, whatever its times. PAID ($5 over x402, or inside a plan with due diligence). The digest names the whole issued document; verify it at /v1/reports/{digest}. materialLimits.simulationRecord carries each simulated try as raw assets, token decimals, price source, block hash and exact calldata, so it can be replayed; a highest passing size is never the exact maximum. A zero-amount call is never a limit (withdrawalBounds). On Morpho V2, forceDeallocate returns penalty SHARES burned and pays nobody: only the withdraw after it pays (exitSimulation.forceDeallocate). control.ownerControl says when owner control is not established; a curator’s Safe is never the owner’s.
name: vault_due_diligence

agentRules.description: What your answer must and must not say. Follow them.

changesSincePrevious.description: Standard figures before and after against the previous report, each changed, below_threshold (moved, under the 1% materiality threshold), unchanged (within a dollar) or not_comparable, with a note that says the move, with both times and models.

completeness.description: Coverage by area, missing fields, currentDecisionStatus, nextCurrentInputExpiryAt, snapshot.

decisionSummary.description: The one decision view model: modelScore, modelBand, highestModelDimension, highestFindingAcrossAllLayers (the lending-book overlay and the controller included), publishedBand, overrideReasons (rule, evidence, readAt), materialFindings, and lines to quote. Lead with highestFindingAcrossAllLayers; never say nothing material was read while materialFindings is not empty; a withheld assessment has no band.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the whole issued document.

dimensions.description: Each risk dimension with its level and what set it.

highestFinding.description: The worst single risk read, level and label. The weighted result never cancels it.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

metricStatus.description: Per input: status, times, expiry, whether the result used it.

notAssessed.description: Risk areas this report did not assess, each with status not assessed, not tested or not established. Say them; the score’s input share does not cover them.

overallAssessment.description: status, publishedBand, publishedScore, partialBand, partialScore, reasonCode, reason, findingsAboveBand, inputsNotCurrent, judgedAt. usableForCurrentDecision false: the score is a historical computation, not a clearance; sensitivity gives each not-current input’s score without it and at its worst. inputsStatus gives present, fresh, aligned, usable and covered per input, five separate answers.

unattributedCapital.description: value (null unless measured), unit, status (measured, not_established or unreconciled_residual), differenceUsd, asOf. Never report null as zero.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

withdrawableFigure.description: The withdrawable figure’s state: zero, dust or unknown, said apart. A dust figure is printed as <$0.01, never $0, and is never the denominator of a percentage (ratioMeaningful false).

withdrawalBounds.description: Taken over positive amounts only: largestTestedSuccess, smallestPositiveTestedFailure (with its revert class), upperBoundJustification and searchExhausted, each null where it does not exist. A call for zero raw units is a zero_amount_test (zeroAmountTests), never a limit. An amount above the simulated holder’s position is not applicable, never failed; one between tested points is only conditionally inferred. materialLimits.simulationRecord.calls carry requestedUsd, quantizedAssetsRaw, actualAsset, actualUsd, decimals, rounding, state and revertClass.

title: Due-diligence report for agents (paid)
